name: Orb · Dither
description: A lit plasma dome quantized to chunky two-tone pixels: lambert light, drifting fbm plasma and a fresnel rim collapse into one luminance, and an 8x8 ordered Bayer matrix — generated procedurally, since GLSL ES 1.0 has neither array initializers nor bitwise ops — snaps it onto a short ink-to-paper tone ladder. Two steps is the classic 1-bit look (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-14 (MIT).
